Based on the provided documents, specifically **Document [2]** ("Largest and heaviest animals :: Heaviest living animals"), the top five heaviest living animals are all whales:

1.  **Blue whale** (Global oceans, including waters off Africa, but not exclusive to Africa)
2.  **North Pacific right whale** (North Pacific Ocean only)
3.  **Southern right whale** (Southern Hemisphere oceans, including coastal waters of South Africa)
4.  **Fin whale** (Global oceans, including waters off Africa)

1.  **Merlot** (62% of red plantings): Predominantly planted on the **Right Bank** (specifically **Saint-Émilion** and **Pomerol**) and in the **Entre-Deux-Mers** area.
2.  **Cabernet Sauvignon** (25% of red plantings): Dominates the **Left Bank**, specifically the **Médoc** and the rest of the left bank of the Gironde estuary.

5.  **Sauvignon Blanc** (36% of white plantings): Widely planted across all white wine regions, with rising popularity; it is a key component in dry white wines from areas like **Graves**, **Pessac-Léognan**, and **Entre-Deux-Mers**.

Exact Answer: The five most popular grape varieties are Merlot (most planted on the Right Bank/Saint-Émilion/Pomerol), Cabernet Sauvignon (most planted on the Left Bank/Médoc), Sémillon (most planted in Sauternes/Barsac and widely across white regions), Cabernet Franc (widely distributed, key on the Right Bank), and Sauvignon Blanc (widely distributed, key in dry white regions like Graves/Entre-Deux-Mers).
